lead.hed: USS Ross makes a scheduled port call in Mombasa
lead.insight: Navy, Sept. 8: Arleigh Burke-class destroyer USS Ross (DDG 71) arrived in Mombasa, Kenya, on Sept. 5 for a scheduled visit. USNI News notes the stop as the fleet looks at African ports amid longer deployments. Ross has been operating with Fifth Fleet support to Operation Epic Fury, the Navy said.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy photo · DVIDS 9892869 · Public domain · Flight operations aboard USS Ross (DDG 71), Aug. 26, 2026.
